pr_title: feat: improve DependencyDescriptor to combine import_assertions with dynamic_import_assertions
pr_body:
**Description:**

This makes the `DependencyDescriptor` interface a little less error prone by combining `import_assertions` with `dynamic_import_assertions`.

**BREAKING CHANGE:** Combines `dynamic_import_assertiosn` with `import_assertions` in `DependencyDescriptor`

**Related issue (if exists):** https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/3137

Closes #3137
